paragraphs.text: A study at Brenner University followed 120 secondary school students for a term, recording their sleep with wristbands and comparing it with their test results. Students who slept at least eight hours on school nights scored, on average, 7 per cent higher in mathematics than those who slept less than seven.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The researchers were careful not to claim that sleep alone caused the difference. Students who slept longer also tended to have more regular routines and to spend less time on their phones in the evening, and either factor might affect results.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: One finding was clearer. Students who caught up on sleep at weekends did not perform better than those who slept little throughout the week. A long lie-in on Saturday, the authors conclude, cannot undo the effects of five short nights.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The team recommends that schools teach students about sleep in the same way they teach about diet and exercise. They also suggest that homework deadlines should not be set for late evening, since many students stay up to meet them.
paragraphs.label: D

items.prompt: The students’ sleep was measured using

explanation.en: “recording their sleep with wristbands” → B. Phones (D) come up later as a habit, not as a way of measuring.
explanation.kk: «recording their sleep with wristbands» → B. Телефон (D) кейін өлшеу құралы ретінде емес, әдет ретінде аталады.
explanation.ru: «recording their sleep with wristbands» → B. Телефоны (D) упоминаются позже как привычка, а не как способ измерения.

items.prompt: The researchers did not say that sleep alone caused the better results because

options.text: the group of students was too small.
some students did not wear their wristbands.
other habits could also explain the difference.

explanation.en: Longer sleepers also had “more regular routines” and used their phones less — “either factor might affect results” → D. The text gives no other reasons.
explanation.kk: Көбірек ұйықтағандардың «more regular routines» те болған, телефонды да аз қолданған — «either factor might affect results» → D. Басқа себептер мәтінде аталмайды.
explanation.ru: Те, кто спал дольше, имели и «more regular routines», и меньше пользовались телефоном — «either factor might affect results» → D. Остальные причины текст не называет.

items.quote: Students who caught up on sleep at weekends did not perform better than those who slept little throughout the week
items.prompt: Students who slept longer at weekends

options.text: did better than all the other students.
did not perform better than those who slept little all week.
spent less time on their phones.

explanation.en: “did not perform better than those who slept little throughout the week” → B. C and D describe students who slept longer every night (paragraph B), not weekend catch-up sleepers.
explanation.kk: «did not perform better than those who slept little throughout the week» → B. C мен D демалыста ұйқы толықтырушыларға емес, күнде көп ұйықтағандарға (B абзацы) қатысты.
explanation.ru: «did not perform better than those who slept little throughout the week» → B. C и D относятся к тем, кто спал дольше каждую ночь (абзац B), а не к «догоняющим» в выходные.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–3. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: The team recommends that schools teach students about sleep
items.prompt: Which TWO recommendations does the research team make?

options.text: not setting homework deadlines for late evening

explanation.en: “recommends that schools teach students about sleep” and “homework deadlines should not be set for late evening” → A and D. A later start (B) and banning phones (C) sound logical but are not in the text.
explanation.kk: «recommends that schools teach students about sleep» және «homework deadlines should not be set for late evening» → A және D. Сабақты кеш бастау (B) мен телефонға тыйым (C) қисынды, бірақ мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «recommends that schools teach students about sleep» и «homework deadlines should not be set for late evening» → A и D. Более поздний старт (B) и запрет телефонов (C) звучат логично, но в тексте их нет.
